title: Workflow label terms
summary: Shared Title Case labels for workflow statuses, priorities and related values, ready for the screens on the 0.43 line.
changes: Add Title Case labels for every stored ticket, case, consultation and application status, including In Progress, Waiting on User and Under Review.
Add label groups for priorities, Shelter case types, Recruitment role categories, and pet sex and neutering status.
Document the workflow labels in the glossary; stored values stay snake_case.
version_rationale: Minor: opens the 0.43 language and keywords line with new shared label groups.
validation: TerminologyGlossaryTest covers every label group and the en fallback.
composer pre-merge on the pull request branch.
known_limitations: Screens still show stored values until the following 0.43 releases wire them to these labels.
rollback: Redeploy the previous release package. No database change is involved.
